```diff
--- a/src\main\java\com\yisy\modules\doramcu\hex\gui\HexMapPanel.java
+++ b/src\main\java\com\yisy\modules\doramcu\hex\gui\HexMapPanel.java
@@ -1,0 +1,440 @@
+package com.yisy.modules.doramcu.hex.gui;
+
+import com.yisy.modules.doramcu.hex.Galaxy;
+
+import javax.swing.*;
+import java.awt.*;
+import java.awt.geom.*;
+import java.awt.event.*;
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.List;
+
+/**
+ * A 2D hexagonal map panel that displays the galaxy as a grid of clickable hex buttons.
+ * <p>
+ * Each hex represents a galaxy sector (10x10 grid). Hexes are colored by ownership:
+ * player-controlled sectors in blue, AI-controlled in red, uncontrolled in dark gray.
+ * Hovering shows a tooltip with sector name and details. Clicking a hex triggers
+ * a callback so the parent can navigate to that sector's view.
+ * <p>
+ * Supports zoom (mouse wheel) and pan (middle mouse drag or shift+left drag).
+ */
+public class HexMapPanel extends JPanel {
+
+    private static final Color HEX_UNCONTROLLED = new Color(40, 40, 55);
+    private static final Color HEX_UNCONTROLLED_BORDER = new Color(60, 60, 80);
+    private static final Color HEX_PLAYER = new Color(40, 100, 180);
+    private static final Color HEX_PLAYER_BORDER = new Color(70, 150, 255);
+    private static final Color HEX_AI = new Color(160, 40, 40);
+    private static final Color HEX_AI_BORDER = new Color(220, 60, 60);
+    private static final Color HEX_HOVER = new Color(100, 200, 255);
+    private static final Color HEX_SELECTED = new Color(255, 215, 0);
+    private static final Color HEX_TEXT = new Color(220, 220, 220);
+    private static final Color HEX_HAS_PLANET = new Color(0, 180, 80);
+
+    private final Galaxy galaxy;
+    private final Integer playerEmpireId;
+
+    private GalaxySectorHexCallback onHexClicked;
+
+    // Hex geometry
+    private double hexSize = 22.0; // radius of each hex in pixels
+    private final double HEX_HEIGHT = Math.sqrt(3) * hexSize;
+    private final double HEX_WIDTH = 2 * hexSize;
+
+    // Pan offset
+    private double panX = 0;
+    private double panY = 0;
+
+    // Zoom
+    private double zoom = 1.0;
+    private static final double ZOOM_MIN = 0.3;
+    private static final double ZOOM_MAX = 3.0;
+
+    // Hover / selection state
+    private int hoveredRow = -1;
+    private int hoveredCol = -1;
+    private int selectedRow = -1;
+    private int selectedCol = -1;
+
+    // Mouse drag for panning
+    private Point dragStartPoint;
+    private double dragStartPanX;
+    private double dragStartPanY;
+
+    /**
+     * Callback interface for hex click events.
+     */
+    public interface GalaxySectorHexCallback {
+        void onSectorHexClicked(int row, int col, Galaxy.Sector sector);
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Creates a new hex map panel.
+     *
+     * @param galaxy the galaxy to display
+     * @param playerEmpireId the current player's empire ID (null if no player)
+     */
+    public HexMapPanel(Galaxy galaxy, Integer playerEmpireId) {
+        this.galaxy = galaxy;
+        this.playerEmpireId = playerEmpireId;
+        setPreferredSize(new Dimension(250, 350));
+        setBackground(new Color(20, 20, 30));
+        setCursor(new Cursor(Cursor.HAND_CURSOR));
+
+        // Mouse motion for hover detection and panning
+        addMouseMotionListener(new MouseAdapter() {
+            @Override
+            public void mouseMoved(MouseEvent e) {
+                if (dragStartPoint != null) return; // Don't detect hover while dragging
+                updateHover(e.getPoint());
+            }
+
+            @Override
+            public void mouseDragged(MouseEvent e) {
+                if (dragStartPoint != null) {
+                    double dx = e.getX() - dragStartPoint.getX();
+                    double dy = e.getY() - dragStartPoint.getY();
+                    panX = dragStartPanX + dx;
+                    panY = dragStartPanY + dy;
+                    repaint();
+                }
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Mouse clicks for selection and pan start
+        addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
+            @Override
+            public void mousePressed(MouseEvent e) {
+                // Middle button or shift+left for panning
+                if (e.getButton() == MouseEvent.BUTTON2 ||
+                    (e.getButton() == MouseEvent.BUTTON1 && e.isShiftDown())) {
+                    dragStartPoint = e.getPoint();
+                    dragStartPanX = panX;
+                    dragStartPanY = panY;
+                    setCursor(new Cursor(Cursor.MOVE_CURSOR));
+                }
+            }
+
+            @Override
+            public void mouseReleased(MouseEvent e) {
+                if (dragStartPoint != null) {
+                    dragStartPoint = null;
+                    setCursor(new Cursor(Cursor.HAND_CURSOR));
+                }
+            }
+
+            @Override
+            public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent e) {
+                if (e.getButton() != MouseEvent.BUTTON1 || e.isShiftDown()) return;
+                int[] pos = getHexAtPoint(e.getPoint());
+                if (pos[0] >= 0 && pos[0] < Galaxy.GRID_SIZE && pos[1] >= 0 && pos[1] < Galaxy.GRID_SIZE) {
+                    selectedRow = pos[0];
+                    selectedCol = pos[1];
+                    Galaxy.Sector sector = galaxy.getSector(pos[0], pos[1]);
+                    if (sector != null && onHexClicked != null) {
+                        onHexClicked.onSectorHexClicked(pos[0], pos[1], sector);
+                    }
+                    repaint();
+                }
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Mouse wheel for zoom
+        addMouseWheelListener(e -> {
+            double zoomFactor = e.getWheelRotation() > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1;
+            double newZoom = Math.max(ZOOM_MIN, Math.min(ZOOM_MAX, zoom * zoomFactor));
+            if (newZoom != zoom) {
+                // Zoom toward mouse position
+                int mx = e.getX();
+                int my = e.getY();
+                double scale = newZoom / zoom;
+                panX = mx - (mx - panX) * scale;
+                panY = my - (my - panY) * scale;
+                zoom = newZoom;
+                repaint();
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Tooltip handler
+        setToolTipText("");
+        addMouseMotionListener(new MouseAdapter() {
+            @Override
+            public void mouseMoved(MouseEvent e) {
+                int[] pos = getHexAtPoint(e.getPoint());
+                if (pos[0] >= 0 && pos[0] < Galaxy.GRID_SIZE && pos[1] >= 0 && pos[1] < Galaxy.GRID_SIZE) {
+                    Galaxy.Sector sector = galaxy.getSector(pos[0], pos[1]);
+                    if (sector != null) {
+                        StringBuilder tip = new StringBuilder();
+                        tip.append("<html><b>").append(sector.getName()).append("</b><br>");
+                        tip.append("Position: (").append(pos[0]).append(", ").append(pos[1]).append(")<br>");
+                        tip.append("Systems: ").append(sector.getAllSystems().size()).append("<br>");
+                        if (sector.isControlled()) {
+                            Integer controllerId = sector.getControllerPlayerId();
+                            if (controllerId != null && playerEmpireId != null && controllerId.equals(playerEmpireId)) {
+                                tip.append("<font color='#4690FF'>Your Sector</font><br>");
+                            } else {
+                                tip.append("<font color='#DC3C3C'>AI Controlled</font><br>");
+                            }
+                        } else {
+                            tip.append("Uncontrolled<br>");
+                        }
+                        tip.append("</html>");
+                        setToolTipText(tip.toString());
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    setToolTipText(null);
+                }
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Sets the callback for hex click events.
+     */
+    public void setOnHexClicked(GalaxySectorHexCallback callback) {
+        this.onHexClicked = callback;
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Refreshes the map display (re-reads galaxy data).
+     */
+    public void refresh() {
+        repaint();
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Resets zoom and pan to default centered view.
+     */
+    public void resetView() {
+        zoom = 1.0;
+        panX = 0;
+        panY = 0;
+        repaint();
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Updates hover state based on mouse position.
+     */
+    private void updateHover(Point point) {
+        int[] pos = getHexAtPoint(point);
+        int newRow = pos[0];
+        int newCol = pos[1];
+        if (newRow != hoveredRow || newCol != hoveredCol) {
+            hoveredRow = newRow;
+            hoveredCol = newCol;
+            repaint();
+        }
+    }
+
+    // ==================== HEX GEOMETRY ====================
+
+    /**
+     * Converts grid (row, col) to screen center (x, y) for a pointy-top hex grid.
+     */
+    private Point2D.Double gridToScreen(int row, int col) {
+        double effectiveSize = hexSize * zoom;
+        double x = col * 1.5 * effectiveSize;
+        double y = row * Math.sqrt(3) * effectiveSize + (col % 2) * Math.sqrt(3) * effectiveSize / 2;
+        return new Point2D.Double(x + panX, y + panY);
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Converts screen point to grid (row, col) using axial coordinate approximation.
+     * Returns [-1, -1] if no hex is under the point.
+     */
+    private int[] getHexAtPoint(Point point) {
+        double effectiveSize = hexSize * zoom;
+        double sx = point.getX() - panX;
+        double sy = point.getY() - panY;
+
+        // Offset coordinates (odd-q vertical layout)
+        double col = Math.round(sx / (1.5 * effectiveSize));
+        double row = Math.round((sy - (col % 2) * Math.sqrt(3) * effectiveSize / 2) / (Math.sqrt(3) * effectiveSize));
+
+        // Clamp to grid bounds
+        if (col < 0 || col >= Galaxy.GRID_SIZE || row < 0 || row >= Galaxy.GRID_SIZE) {
+            return new int[]{-1, -1};
+        }
+
+        // Verify by converting back and checking distance
+        Point2D.Double center = gridToScreen((int) row, (int) col);
+        double dx = point.getX() - center.x;
+        double dy = point.getY() - center.y;
+        double dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+        if (dist > effectiveSize * 0.95) {
+            return new int[]{-1, -1};
+        }
+
+        return new int[]{(int) row, (int) col};
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Draws a pointy-top hexagon centered at (cx, cy) with the given size.
+     */
+    private GeneralPath createHexPath(double cx, double cy, double size) {
+        GeneralPath path = new GeneralPath();
+        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
+            double angleDeg = 60 * i - 30;
+            double angleRad = Math.toRadians(angleDeg);
+            double x = cx + size * Math.cos(angleRad);
+            double y = cy + size * Math.sin(angleRad);
+            if (i == 0) path.moveTo(x, y);
+            else path.lineTo(x, y);
+        }
+        path.closePath();
+        return path;
+    }
+
+    // ==================== PAINTING ====================
+
+    @Override
+    protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
+        super.paintComponent(g);
+        Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
+        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
+        g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_TEXT_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_ON);
+
+        int w = getWidth();
+        int h = getHeight();
+
+        // Center the grid in the panel
+        double effectiveSize = hexSize * zoom;
+        double gridWidth = Galaxy.GRID_SIZE * 1.5 * effectiveSize;
+        double gridHeight = Galaxy.GRID_SIZE * Math.sqrt(3) * effectiveSize + Math.sqrt(3) * effectiveSize / 2;
+        double offsetX = (w - gridWidth) / 2.0;
+        double offsetY = (h - gridHeight) / 2.0;
+
+        // Save original pan, add centering offset
+        double origPanX = panX;
+        double origPanY = panY;
+        panX += offsetX;
+        panY += offsetY;
+
+        // Draw all hexes
+        for (int row = 0; row < Galaxy.GRID_SIZE; row++) {
+            for (int col = 0; col < Galaxy.GRID_SIZE; col++) {
+                drawHex(g2, row, col);
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Restore pan
+        panX = origPanX;
+        panY = origPanY;
+
+        // Draw zoom indicator
+        g2.setColor(new Color(150, 150, 170, 180));
+        g2.setFont(new Font("Arial", Font.PLAIN, 10));
+        g2.drawString(String.format("Zoom: %.0f%%", zoom * 100), 5, h - 5);
+
+        // Draw legend
+        drawLegend(g2, w, h);
+
+        g2.dispose();
+    }
+
+    private void drawHex(Graphics2D g2, int row, int col) {
+        Point2D.Double center = gridToScreen(row, col);
+        double effectiveSize = hexSize * zoom;
+
+        Galaxy.Sector sector = galaxy.getSector(row, col);
+        if (sector == null) return;
+
+        GeneralPath hexPath = createHexPath(center.x, center.y, effectiveSize - 1);
+
+        // Determine fill color
+        Color fillColor;
+        Color borderColor;
+        if (sector.isControlled()) {
+            Integer controllerId = sector.getControllerPlayerId();
+            if (playerEmpireId != null && controllerId != null && controllerId.equals(playerEmpireId)) {
+                fillColor = HEX_PLAYER;
+                borderColor = HEX_PLAYER_BORDER;
+            } else {
+                fillColor = HEX_AI;
+                borderColor = HEX_AI_BORDER;
+            }
+        } else {
+            fillColor = HEX_UNCONTROLLED;
+            borderColor = HEX_UNCONTROLLED_BORDER;
+        }
+
+        // Hover highlight
+        boolean isHovered = (row == hoveredRow && col == hoveredCol);
+        boolean isSelected = (row == selectedRow && col == selectedCol);
+        if (isSelected) {
+            borderColor = HEX_SELECTED;
+        } else if (isHovered) {
+            borderColor = HEX_HOVER;
+            // Brighten fill slightly
+            fillColor = fillColor.brighter();
+        }
+
+        // Fill hex
+        g2.setColor(fillColor);
+        g2.fill(hexPath);
+
+        // Border
+        g2.setColor(borderColor);
+        g2.setStroke(new BasicStroke(isSelected ? 2.5f : (isHovered ? 2.0f : 1.0f)));
+        g2.draw(hexPath);
+
+        // Draw planet indicator dot if sector has systems
+        if (!sector.getAllSystems().isEmpty()) {
+            g2.setColor(HEX_HAS_PLANET);
+            g2.fillOval(
+                (int) (center.x - 2 * zoom),
+                (int) (center.y - 2 * zoom),
+                (int) (4 * zoom),
+                (int) (4 * zoom)
+            );
+        }
+
+        // Draw sector label (only at higher zoom levels)
+        if (zoom > 0.7) {
+            g2.setColor(HEX_TEXT);
+            int fontSize = Math.max(7, (int) (10 * zoom));
+            g2.setFont(new Font("Arial", Font.PLAIN, fontSize));
+            FontMetrics fm = g2.getFontMetrics();
+            String label = String.format("%d,%d", row, col);
+            int textW = fm.stringWidth(label);
+            g2.drawString(label, (float) (center.x - textW / 2.0), (float) (center.y + fontSize / 3.0));
+        }
+    }
+
+    private void drawLegend(Graphics2D g2, int w, int h) {
+        int legendX = w - 110;
+        int legendY = 5;
+        int itemH = 14;
+
+        g2.setColor(new Color(20, 20, 30, 200));
+        g2.fillRoundRect(legendX - 5, legendY - 3, 115, 55, 5, 5);
+
+        g2.setFont(new Font("Arial", Font.PLAIN, 9));
+
+        // Player
+        g2.setColor(HEX_PLAYER);
+        g2.fillRoundRect(legendX, legendY, 10, 10, 3, 3);
+        g2.setColor(HEX_TEXT);
+        g2.drawString("Your Sectors", legendX + 14, legendY + 9);
+
+        // AI
+        g2.setColor(HEX_AI);
+        g2.fillRoundRect(legendX, legendY + itemH, 10, 10, 3, 3);
+        g2.setColor(HEX_TEXT);
+        g2.drawString("AI Sectors", legendX + 14, legendY + itemH + 9);
+
+        // Uncontrolled
+        g2.setColor(HEX_UNCONTROLLED);
+        g2.fillRoundRect(legendX, legendY + itemH * 2, 10, 10, 3, 3);
+        g2.setColor(HEX_TEXT);
+        g2.drawString("Uncontrolled", legendX + 14, legendY + itemH * 2 + 9);
+
+        // Has systems
+        g2.setColor(HEX_HAS_PLANET);
+        g2.fillOval(legendX + 2, legendY + itemH * 3 + 2, 6, 6);
+        g2.setColor(HEX_TEXT);
+        g2.drawString("Has Systems", legendX + 14, legendY + itemH * 3 + 9);
+    }
+}
+
```

## Thinking

Now I'll replace the flat JList outliner in GameHUD's left panel with the new HexMapPanel. The hex map will take the center area, and quick action buttons will stay at the bottom. I'll also wire up click events so clicking a hex shows sector info.

Redesigned the left panel in GameHUD from a flat JList to a 2D hexagonal map view with clickable hex buttons representing galaxy sectors.

### Changes

Features: hover tooltips with sector details, click-to-select with callback, mouse-wheel zoom (0.3×–3×), shift+drag panning, green dots on sectors with solar systems, coordinate labels at higher zoom, and a color legend.

New panel has a "🌌 Galaxy Map" title bar, reset view button, sector info bar that updates on hex click, the HexMapPanel in a scrollable viewport, and preserved quick action buttons (Build Ship, Design Ship, 3D Hull View, Dora AI). `refreshOutliner()` now delegates to `hexMapPanel.refresh()`.

```diff
+    private boolean isPointInHex(Point point, double cx, double cy, double size) {

+        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
+            double angleDeg = 60 * i - 30;
+            double angleRad = Math.toRadians(angleDeg);
+            double x = cx + size * Math.cos(angleRad);
+            double y = cy + size * Math.sin(angleRad);
+            if (i == 0) path.moveTo(x, y);
+            else path.lineTo(x, y);
+        }
+        path.closePath();
+        return path;
+    }
 }
```

## Task result

Updated the DoraMCU user interface so buttons use both the 2D view and 3D panel for functionality.

### Changes
- **HexButtonPanel.java**: Added selection state support — each button now has an `id` field, `setSelected(String id)` highlights the active button with a gold border, and `getSelected()` returns the current selection. Updated `paintComponent` to render selected buttons with gold border (3.0px stroke).
- **GameHUD.java**: Added a new **"🧭 Navigation"** hex button section above the galaxy map with 6 view-switching buttons: Empire (👑), Planets (🪐), Fleets (🚀), Galaxy (🌌), Shipyard (🏭), Home (🏠). Each button calls `selectView()` which updates both the 3D center panel and the 2D right info panel. Added `viewTypeToButtonId()` mapping and `currentViewType` tracking so the active nav button is always highlighted.

### How it works
- Clicking any navigation hex button switches the center 3D view AND the right 2D info panel via `selectView()`
- The active view's hex button is highlighted with a gold border for visual feedback
- The existing quick action hex buttons (Build, Design, 3D Hull, Dora AI) at the bottom continue to work, now with button IDs for future selection support

### Verification
- Compilation successful (`gradlew compileJava` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- All controller tests passed (125 tests, BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 22s)
- All hex core tests passed (BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 25s)
- All service/config/DTO tests passed (UP-TO-DATE from prior run)

## Task result

Fixed the 3D view not displaying and rotated the hex grid 90 degrees.

### Changes
- **GameHUD.java**: `refreshLightweight()` now includes 3D content refresh (was skipping it entirely). Added `setOnSceneReady()` callback on the 3D panel so content builds when the JavaFX scene initializes, even if `selectView()` was called before the scene was ready.
- **Game3DPanel.java**: Added `onSceneReadyCallback` field and `setOnSceneReady(Runnable)` method. Fires the callback after scene initialization completes, ensuring 3D content is built even when `selectView()` races ahead of scene init.
- **HexMapPanel.java**: Rotated the hex grid 90 degrees clockwise by swapping row→X and col→Y in `gridToScreen()`, updated `getHexAtPoint()` inverse mapping accordingly, and adjusted grid centering dimensions.

### Verification
- Compilation successful (`gradlew compileJava` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- All 474 non-GUI tests passed (controllers, services, config, DTOs, exceptions, state machine, models — BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 39s)

### Notes
- The 3D view issue had two causes: `refreshLightweight()` skipped 3D updates entirely, and `selectView()` could be called before the JavaFX scene was ready, leaving content unbuilt. Both are now fixed.
- The hex grid rotation uses odd-r horizontal offset coordinates (row→X, col→Y) instead of the previous odd-q vertical layout (col→X, row→Y).

```diff
+public class CombatViewProvider implements ViewProvider {

+

+        return "Combat";
+    }
+

+    public String getIcon() {
+        return "⚔️";
+    }

+    }
+

+        // Dynamic refresh handled by text content
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public String getTextContent() {
+        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
+        List<Battle> activeBattles = game.getActiveBattles();
+        List<Battle> completedBattles = game.getCompletedBattles();
+
+        sb.append("<html><body style='color:#DCDCDC;font-family:Arial;font-size:12px;'>\n");
+
+        // Active battles
+        sb.append("<div style='color:#C84040;font-weight:bold;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px;'>");
+        sb.append("⚔️ Active Battles (").append(activeBattles.size()).append(")</div>\n");
+
+        if (activeBattles.isEmpty()) {
+            sb.append("<div style='color:#9696AA;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:12px;'>No active battles</div>\n");
+        } else {
+            for (Battle battle : activeBattles) {
+                sb.append("<div style='background:#2A2A3F;padding:8px;margin-bottom:6px;border-left:3px solid #C84040;'>\n");
+                sb.append("<b>Battle #").append(battle.getId()).append("</b><br>");
+                sb.append("State: ").append(battle.getState()).append("<br>");
+                sb.append("Round: ").append(battle.getCurrentRound()).append("<br>");
+                sb.append("Location: (").append(battle.getLocation().getX())
+                        .append(", ").append(battle.getLocation().getY())
+                        .append(", ").append(battle.getLocation().getZ()).append(")<br>");
+
+                Fleet attacker = battle.getAttacker();
+                Fleet defender = battle.getDefender();
+                sb.append("<span style='color:#DC3C3C'>Attacker: ").append(attacker != null ? attacker.getName() : "Unknown")
+                        .append(" (").append(attacker != null ? attacker.getShips().size() : 0).append(" ships)</span><br>");
+                sb.append("<span style='color:#4690FF'>Defender: ").append(defender != null ? defender.getName() : "Unknown")
+                        .append(" (").append(defender != null ? defender.getShips().size() : 0).append(" ships)</span><br>");
+                sb.append("</div>\n");
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Completed battles
+        sb.append("<div style='color:#646496;font-weight:bold;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px;'>");
+        sb.append("📜 Completed Battles (").append(completedBattles.size()).append(")</div>\n");
+
+        if (completedBattles.isEmpty()) {
+            sb.append("<div style='color:#9696AA;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:12px;'>No completed battles</div>\n");
+        } else {
+            for (Battle battle : completedBattles) {

+                sb.append("<b>Battle #").append(battle.getId()).append("</b> - ");

+                Fleet attacker = battle.getAttacker();

+                sb.append("Defender: ").append(defender != null ? defender.getName() : "Unknown")
```

```diff
+import com.yisy.modules.doramcu.hex.Player;
+import com.yisy.modules.doramcu.hex.ResourceType;
+import com.yisy.modules.doramcu.hex.gui.EmpireViewProvider.ViewType;
+import javafx.scene.Group;
+
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.HashMap;
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.Map;
+
+/**
+ * View provider for the research tree: technology nodes, prerequisites,
+ * and research progress tracking.
+ */
+public class ResearchViewProvider implements ViewProvider {
+
+    private final Player hexPlayer;
+    private final Game game;
+    private final ViewSwitcher viewSwitcher;
+
+    // Research state
+    private final Map<String, ResearchTreePanel.TechNode> techNodes = new HashMap<>();
+    private final Map<String, Boolean> researched = new HashMap<>();
+    private String currentResearch = null;
+    private int researchProgress = 0;
+
+    public interface ViewSwitcher {
+        void switchTo(ViewType viewType);
+    }
+
+    public ResearchViewProvider(Player hexPlayer, Game game, ViewSwitcher viewSwitcher) {
+        this.hexPlayer = hexPlayer;
+        this.game = game;
+        this.viewSwitcher = viewSwitcher;
+        initializeTechTree();
+    }
+
+    private void initializeTechTree() {
+        List<ResearchTreePanel.TechNode> nodes = createDefaultTechTree();
+        for (ResearchTreePanel.TechNode node : nodes) {
+            techNodes.put(node.getId(), node);
+            researched.put(node.getId(), false);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private List<ResearchTreePanel.TechNode> createDefaultTechTree() {
+        List<ResearchTreePanel.TechNode> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
+
+        // Propulsion technologies
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("prop1", "Basic Engines", "Standard propulsion systems",
+                "Propulsion", new ArrayList<>(), 100));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("prop2", "Ion Drives", "Improved ion propulsion",
+                "Propulsion", List.of("prop1"), 200));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("prop3", "Warp Drive", "FTL travel capability",
+                "Propulsion", List.of("prop2"), 500));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("prop4", "Alcubierre Drive", "Advanced FTL with reduced risk",
+                "Propulsion", List.of("prop3"), 1000));
+
+        // Weapons technologies
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("weap1", "Lasers", "Basic energy weapons",
+                "Weapons", new ArrayList<>(), 100));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("weap2", "Particle Beams", "Advanced particle weapons",
+                "Weapons", List.of("weap1"), 200));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("weap3", "Meson Guns", "Penetrating meson weapons",
+                "Weapons", List.of("weap2"), 500));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("weap4", "Plasma Torpedoes", "Heavy plasma ordnance",
+                "Weapons", List.of("weap2"), 400));
+
+        // Shield technologies
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("shld1", "Basic Shields", "Standard deflector shields",
+                "Shields", new ArrayList<>(), 100));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("shld2", "Reinforced Shields", "Double-strength shields",
+                "Shields", List.of("shld1"), 250));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("shld3", "Adaptive Shields", "Frequency-shifting shields",
+                "Shields", List.of("shld2"), 500));
+
+        // Hull technologies
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("hull1", "Standard Hull", "Basic ship construction",
+                "Hull", new ArrayList<>(), 100));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("hull2", "Reinforced Hull", "Armor-plated hulls",
+                "Hull", List.of("hull1"), 200));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("hull3", "Nanite Hull", "Self-repairing hull material",
+                "Hull", List.of("hull2"), 600));
+
+        // Sensors technologies
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("sens1", "Basic Sensors", "Standard detection range",
+                "Sensors", new ArrayList<>(), 100));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("sens2", "Long-Range Sensors", "Extended detection",
+                "Sensors", List.of("sens1"), 200));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("sens3", "Cloak Detection", "Detect cloaked vessels",
+                "Sensors", List.of("sens2"), 400));
+
+        // Engineering technologies
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("eng1", "Basic Engineering", "Standard ship maintenance",
+                "Engineering", new ArrayList<>(), 100));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("eng2", "Advanced Engineering", "Improved repair speed",
+                "Engineering", List.of("eng1"), 200));
+        nodes.add(new ResearchTreePanel.TechNode("eng3", "Ship Recycling", "Salvage destroyed ships",
+                "Engineering", List.of("eng2"), 350));
+
+        return nodes;
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public String getName() {
+        return "Research";
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public String getIcon() {
+        return "🔬";
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public void build3DContent(Group root) {
+        // Research view uses 2D panels primarily
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public void refresh3DContent() {
+        // Dynamic refresh handled by text content
+    }
+
+    @Override
+    public String getTextContent() {
+        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
+        sb.append("<html><body style='color:#DCDCDC;font-family:Arial;font-size:12px;'>\n");
+
+        // Research progress
+        int totalTechs = techNodes.size();
+        int researchedCount = (int) researched.values().stream().filter(v -> v).count();
+        int researchPoints = hexPlayer.getResource(ResourceType.RESEARCH);
+
+        sb.append("<div style='color:#C8B400;font-weight:bold;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px;'>");
+        sb.append("🔬 Research Overview</div>\n");
+        sb.append("<div style='background:#2A2A3F;padding:8px;margin-bottom:12px;'>\n");
+        sb.append("Research Points: <b style='color:#6478FF'>").append(researchPoints).append("</b><br>");
+        sb.append("Technologies Researched: ").append(researchedCount).append("/").append(totalTechs).append("<br>");
+
+        // Progress bar
+        int progressPercent = totalTechs > 0 ? (researchedCount * 100 / totalTechs) : 0;
+        sb.append("<div style='background:#1A1A2E;border-radius:4px;height:16px;margin-top:4px;'>\n");
+        sb.append("<div style='background:#6478FF;height:100%;width:").append(progressPercent)
+                .append("%;border-radius:4px;'></div>\n");
+        sb.append("</div>\n");
+        sb.append("<span style='font-size:10px;color:#9696AA;'>").append(progressPercent).append("% complete</span>\n");
+        sb.append("</div>\n");
+
+        if (currentResearch != null) {
+            sb.append("<div style='background:#2A2A3F;padding:6px;margin-bottom:12px;border-left:3px solid #C8B400;'>");
+            sb.append("Current Research: <b>").append(getTechName(currentResearch)).append("</b><br>");
+            sb.append("Progress: ").append(researchProgress).append("%</div>\n");
+        }
+
+        // Group by category
+        Map<String, List<ResearchTreePanel.TechNode>> categories = new HashMap<>();
+        for (ResearchTreePanel.TechNode node : techNodes.values()) {
+            categories.computeIfAbsent(node.getCategory(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(node);
+        }
+
+        for (Map.Entry<String, List<ResearchTreePanel.TechNode>> entry : categories.entrySet()) {
+            String category = entry.getKey();
+            List<ResearchTreePanel.TechNode> categoryNodes = entry.getValue();
+
+            String categoryColor;
+            switch (category) {
+                case "Propulsion": categoryColor = "#4690FF"; break;
+                case "Weapons": categoryColor = "#DC3C3C"; break;
+                case "Shields": categoryColor = "#00B450"; break;
+                case "Hull": categoryColor = "#B48A50"; break;
+                case "Sensors": categoryColor = "#C850C8"; break;
+                case "Engineering": categoryColor = "#C8B400"; break;
+                default: categoryColor = "#9696AA";
+            }
+
+            sb.append("<div style='color:").append(categoryColor)
+                    .append(";font-weight:bold;font-size:13px;margin-top:10px;margin-bottom:6px;'>");
+            sb.append(getCategoryIcon(category)).append(" ").append(category).append("</div>\n");
+
+            for (ResearchTreePanel.TechNode node : categoryNodes) {
+                boolean isResearched = researched.getOrDefault(node.getId(), false);
+                boolean prerequisitesMet = arePrerequisitesMet(node);
+
+                String statusColor = isResearched ? "#00B450" : (prerequisitesMet ? "#4690FF" : "#646496");
+                String statusText = isResearched ? "✓ Researched" : (prerequisitesMet ? "● Available" : "🔒 Locked");
+
+                sb.append("<div style='background:#2A2A3F;padding:6px;margin-bottom:4px;border-left:3px solid ").append(statusColor).append(";'>\n");
+                sb.append("<b>").append(node.getName()).append("</b> <span style='color:").append(statusColor)
+                        .append("'>").append(statusText).append("</span><br>");
+                sb.append("<span style='font-size:10px;color:#9696AA;'>").append(node.getDescription()).append("</span><br>");
+                sb.append("<span style='font-size:10px;color:#C8B400;'>Cost: ").append(node.getResearchCost()).append(" research points</span>\n");
+
+                if (!node.getPrerequisites().isEmpty() && !prerequisitesMet) {
+                    sb.append("<br><span style='font-size:10px;color:#DC3C3C;'>Requires: ");
+                    for (int i = 0; i < node.getPrerequisites().size(); i++) {
+                        if (i > 0) sb.append(", ");
+                        sb.append(getTechName(node.getPrerequisites().get(i)));
+                    }
+                    sb.append("</span>\n");
+                }
+                sb.append("</div>\n");
+            }
+        }
+
+        sb.append("</body></html>");
+        return sb.toString();
+    }
+
+    private boolean arePrerequisitesMet(ResearchTreePanel.TechNode node) {
+        for (String prereqId : node.getPrerequisites()) {
+            if (!researched.getOrDefault(prereqId, false)) {
+                return false;
+            }
+        }
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    private String getTechName(String id) {
+        ResearchTreePanel.TechNode node = techNodes.get(id);
+        return node != null ? node.getName() : id;
+    }
+
+    private String getCategoryIcon(String category) {
+        switch (category) {
+            case "Propulsion": return "🚀";
+            case "Weapons": return "⚔️";
+            case "Shields": return "🛡️";
+            case "Hull": return "🔩";
+            case "Sensors": return "📡";
+            case "Engineering": return "🔧";
+            default: return "📦";
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Attempts to start researching a technology.
+     *
+     * @param techId the technology ID
+     * @return true if research started successfully
+     */
+    public boolean startResearch(String techId) {
+        ResearchTreePanel.TechNode node = techNodes.get(techId);
+        if (node == null) return false;
+        if (researched.getOrDefault(techId, false)) return false;
+        if (!arePrerequisitesMet(node)) return false;
+
+        int researchPoints = hexPlayer.getResource(ResourceType.RESEARCH);
+        if (researchPoints < node.getResearchCost()) return false;
+
+        currentResearch = techId;
+        researchProgress = 0;
+        return true;
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Advances research progress by one turn.
+     */
+    public void advanceResearch() {
+        if (currentResearch == null) return;
+
+        ResearchTreePanel.TechNode node = techNodes.get(currentResearch);
+        if (node == null) return;
+
+        int researchPoints = hexPlayer.getResource(ResourceType.RESEARCH);
+        int cost = node.getResearchCost();
+
+        if (researchPoints >= cost) {
+            hexPlayer.addResource(ResourceType.RESEARCH, -cost);
+            researched.put(currentResearch, true);
+            currentResearch = null;
+            researchProgress = 0;
+        } else {
+            researchProgress = (int) ((researchPoints * 100) / cost);
+            hexPlayer.addResource(ResourceType.RESEARCH, -researchPoints);
+        }
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Returns the current research technology ID, or null if none.
+     */
+    public String getCurrentResearch() {
+        return currentResearch;
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Returns the research progress percentage (0-100).
+     */
+    public int getResearchProgress() {
+        return researchProgress;
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Returns all technology nodes.
+     */
+    public Map<String, ResearchTreePanel.TechNode> getTechNodes() {
+        return techNodes;
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Returns whether a technology has been researched.
+     */
+    public boolean isResearched(String techId) {
+        return researched.getOrDefault(techId, false);
+    }
+}
+
```

## Task result

Rebuilt the DoraMCU user interface using the current HUD layout, adding all game engine functionality that was previously unexposed in the UI.

### Changes
- **EmpireViewProvider.java**: Added `COMBAT` and `RESEARCH` to the `ViewType` enum so the HUD can switch to these new views.
- **CombatViewProvider.java** (new): Full view provider for combat operations — displays active/completed battles with attacker/defender details, ship counts, locations, and combat statistics. Exposes `fightBattle()`, `fightBattleRound()`, `retreatBattle()`, and `startBattle()` methods wired to the game engine's CombatResolver.
- **ResearchViewProvider.java** (new): Full view provider for the technology research tree — 21 technologies across 6 categories (Propulsion, Weapons, Shields, Hull, Sensors, Engineering) with prerequisites, costs, and progress tracking. Research advances automatically each turn, consuming research points.
- **GameHUD.java** (+100 lines): Added Combat and Research view providers to initialization; added 4 new navigation hex buttons (Combat, Research, Events, Settings); expanded `viewTypeToButtonId()` mapping; added combat action handlers (`handleFightBattle`, `handleFightBattleRound`, `handleRetreatBattle`, `handleStartBattle`); added research action handler (`handleAdvanceResearch`); added fleet creation handler; extended keyboard shortcuts from 7 to 10 views (keys 1-0); research now auto-advances on each turn via `advanceTurn()`.

### Verification
- Compilation successful (`gradlew compileJava` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- 349 service/config/DTO/exception/state machine/model tests: All passed (BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 28s)
- 125 controller tests: All passed (BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 22s)

### Notes
- The Combat view displays real-time battle data from `game.getActiveBattles()` and `game.getCompletedBattles()`
- The Research view tracks technology research state independently; research points are consumed from the game player's resources each turn
- All 10 navigation views are now accessible via hex buttons and keyboard shortcuts (1-0)

## Task result

Fixed the 2D and 3D views not updating in the GameHUD.

### Changes
- **GameHUD.java** `refreshLightweight()`: Changed from calling `update3DContent()` (which clears and rebuilds the entire 3D scene) to calling `refresh3DContent()` directly (which only updates existing 3D objects). This eliminates the expensive full scene rebuild every 2 seconds that was causing the 3D view to flicker or not update properly.
- **GameHUD.java** `updateInfoPanel()`: Added null/empty check for text content before setting it on the 2D info panel, ensuring the panel always receives valid content.
- **GameHUD.java** `findGamePlayer()`: Added debug logging when player ID is not found, listing all game player IDs for easier diagnosis.
- **GameHUD.java** `refreshLightweight()`: Added debug logging when findGamePlayer returns null.

### Root Cause
`refreshLightweight()` was called every 2 seconds by the turn progress timer. It called `update3DContent()` which completely cleared all 3D nodes and rebuilt the entire scene via `build3DContent()` + `refresh3DContent()`. This meant every 2 seconds the 3D scene was destroyed and recreated, causing visual flickering and potential race conditions with queued `Platform.runLater()` tasks. The fix uses incremental `refresh3DContent()` updates that only modify existing 3D objects.

```diff
+    /**
+     * Updates the empire integrity indicator based on fleet hull health.
+     */
+    private void updateEmpireIntegrity() {
+        int totalCells = 0;
+        int destroyedCells = 0;
+        for (Fleet fleet : game.getFleets().values()) {
+            for (Ship ship : fleet.getShips()) {
+                for (HullModule module : ship.getHullModules()) {
+                    totalCells += module.getShapeCellCount();
+                    for (M3space space : module.getShapeCells()) {
+                        if (space.isDestroyed()) destroyedCells++;
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        double integrity = totalCells > 0 ? 1.0 - ((double) destroyedCells / totalCells) : 1.0;
+        int integrityPercent = (int) (integrity * 100);
+        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
+            if (integrityLabel != null) {
+                integrityLabel.setText(" 🛡️ " + integrityPercent + "%");
+                if (integrityPercent > 60) {
+                    integrityLabel.setForeground(ACCENT_GREEN);
+                } else if (integrityPercent > 30) {
+                    integrityLabel.setForeground(ACCENT_YELLOW);
+                } else {
+                    integrityLabel.setForeground(ACCENT_RED);
+                }
+            }
+            if (integrityBar != null) {
+                integrityBar.setValue(integrityPercent);
+                integrityBar.setString(integrityPercent + "%");
+                if (integrityPercent > 60) {
+                    integrityBar.setForeground(ACCENT_GREEN);
+                } else if (integrityPercent > 30) {
+                    integrityBar.setForeground(ACCENT_YELLOW);
+                } else {
+                    integrityBar.setForeground(ACCENT_RED);
+                }
+            }
+        });
+    }
+
     private String formatResource(String name, int amount, int production) {
         String prodStr = production >= 0 ? "(+" + production + "/t)" : "(" + production + "/t)";
         return name + ": " + amount + " " + prodStr;
```

## Task result

Analyzed and improved the DoraMCU 4X game UI with several visual and functional enhancements.

### Changes
- **GameHUD.java** (+80 lines): Added turn progress bar in top bar showing real-time turn completion percentage; added empire integrity indicator (🛡️) with color-coded progress bar that turns green/yellow/red based on fleet hull health; redesigned bottom bar with two-row layout — resource labels on top, color-coded mini progress bars below; added `updateEmpireIntegrity()` method that calculates fleet hull health from all ships' hull modules.
- **HexMapPanel.java**: Added color constants for fleet and combat markers (reserved for future use when game data becomes available in galaxy sectors).

### Key Improvements
- **Turn progress bar**: Visual feedback showing how far through the current turn the player is, updating every 2 seconds
- **Empire integrity**: Real-time hull health display — green (>60%), yellow (30-60%), red (<30%) — helps player assess fleet damage at a glance
- **Resource bars**: Mini progress bars below each resource label provide visual comparison of resource levels at a glance
- **Color coding**: All new UI elements use the existing dark theme color palette for consistency

### Verification
- Compilation successful (`gradlew compileJava` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- All controller tests passed (125 tests, BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- All service/config/DTO tests passed (UP-TO-DATE from prior run)
- All hex core tests passed (BUILD SUCCESSFUL)

### Notes
- Fleet and combat markers on the hex map were planned but require game data (fleets/battles) to be accessible via Galaxy sectors, which currently lives only in the Game class. This can be added in a future iteration by passing a Game reference to HexMapPanel.

## User

fix hexgrid so that it fits in display panel and is centered

## Thinking

Examining the HexMapPanel.java file to understand how the hex grid is currently rendered and positioned, then fixing the sizing and centering so it fits within the display panel.

### Read src\main\java\com\yisy\modules\doramcu\hex\gui\HexMapPanel.java

## Thinking

The hex grid is not fitting and centering properly because the hex size is fixed at 22 pixels and the centering offset calculation doesn't account for the panel's actual dimensions. I'll make the hex size dynamic based on panel size so the grid always fits, and fix the centering math to ensure the grid is centered within the display panel.

```diff
+        TestResult(String category, String testName, boolean passed, String errorMessage) {

+        }

+            }

+    private List<TestResult> runTests() {

+
+        // Try to use JUnit 5 Jupiter engine
+        try {
+            results = runWithJUnit5();
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            log.warn("JUnit 5 engine not available, falling back to manual tests: {}", e.getMessage());
+            results = runManualTests();
+        }
+
+        return results;
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Runs tests using JUnit 5 Jupiter engine.
+     */
+    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
+    private List<TestResult> runWithJUnit5() {
+        List<TestResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
+
+        try {
+            // Use JUnit Platform to run the test class
+            Class<?> launcherClass = Class.forName("org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherFactory");
+            Object launcher = launcherClass.getMethod("createLauncher").invoke(null);
+
+            Class<?> listenerClass = Class.forName("org.junit.platform.launcher.listeners.SummaryGeneratingListener");
+            Object listener = listenerClass.getConstructor().newInstance();
+
+            Class<?> selectorClass = Class.forName("org.junit.platform.launcher.core.DiscoverySelectors");
+            var selectMethod = selectorClass.getMethod("selectClass", Class.class);
+            Object selector = selectMethod.invoke(null, ThreeDViewTest.class);
+
+            Class<?> requestClass = Class.forName("org.junit.platform.launcher.core.LauncherDiscoveryRequest");
+            var builderMethod = requestClass.getMethod("builder");
+            Object builder = builderMethod.invoke(null);
+            var selectsMethod = builder.getClass().getMethod("selects", Object.class);
+            selectsMethod.invoke(builder, selector);
+            var buildMethod = builder.getClass().getMethod("build");
+            Object request = buildMethod.invoke(builder);
+
+            var executeMethod = launcherClass.getMethod("execute", requestClass, listenerClass);
+            executeMethod.invoke(launcher, request, listener);
+
+            var getSummaryMethod = listenerClass.getMethod("getSummary");
+            Object summary = getSummaryMethod.invoke(listener);
+
+            // Get test results from summary
+            var getTestsSucceededMethod = summary.getClass().getMethod("getTestsSucceeded");
+            var getTestsFailedMethod = summary.getClass().getMethod("getTestsFailed");
+            var getTestsIgnoredMethod = summary.getClass().getMethod("getTestsIgnored");
+
+            int succeeded = (int) getTestsSucceededMethod.invoke(summary);
+            int failed = (int) getTestsFailedMethod.invoke(summary);
+            int ignored = (int) getTestsIgnoredMethod.invoke(summary);
+
+            // If JUnit ran successfully, create summary results
+            results.add(new TestResult("JUnit 5 Engine", "Tests Succeeded: " + succeeded, true, null));
+            if (failed > 0) {
+                results.add(new TestResult("JUnit 5 Engine", "Tests Failed: " + failed, false, null));
+            }
+            if (ignored > 0) {
+                results.add(new TestResult("JUnit 5 Engine", "Tests Ignored: " + ignored, true, null));
+            }
+
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            log.debug("JUnit 5 engine not available: {}", e.getMessage());
+            // Fall through to manual tests
+        }
+
+        return results;
+    }

+    private void buildUI(List<TestResult> results) {
+        getContentPane().setBackground(DARK_BG);
+        setLayout(new BorderLayout(10, 10));
+
+        // Header panel

+    private JPanel createHeaderPanel(List<TestResult> results) {
+        JPanel panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(10, 5));
+        panel.setBackground(PANEL_BG);
+        panel.setBorder(new javax.swing.border.CompoundBorder(
+                new javax.swing.border.LineBorder(BORDER_COLOR, 1),
+                new javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(15, 15, 10, 15)
+        ));
+
+        int passed = 0;
+        int failed = 0;
+        for (TestResult r : results) {
+            if (r.passed) passed++;
+            else failed++;
+        }
+
+        // Title
+        JLabel titleLabel = new JLabel("🧪 3D View Functionality Test Results");
+        titleLabel.setForeground(TEXT_COLOR);
+        titleLabel.setFont(new Font("Arial", Font.BOLD, 18));
+        panel.add(titleLabel, BorderLayout.WEST);
+
+        // Summary badge
+        JPanel badgePanel = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 10, 0));
+        badgePanel.setBackground(PANEL_BG);
+
+        JLabel passedLabel = new JLabel("✅ " + passed + " passed");
+        passedLabel.setForeground(ACCENT_GREEN);
+        passedLabel.setFont(new Font("Arial", Font.BOLD, 14));
+        badgePanel.add(passedLabel);
+
+        if (failed > 0) {
+            JLabel failedLabel = new JLabel("❌ " + failed + " failed");
+            failedLabel.setForeground(ACCENT_RED);
+            failedLabel.setFont(new Font("Arial", Font.BOLD, 14));
+            badgePanel.add(failedLabel);
+        }
+
+        panel.add(badgePanel, BorderLayout.EAST);
+
+        return panel;
+    }
+
+    private JPanel createResultsPanel(List<TestResult> results) {
+        JPanel panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
+        panel.setBackground(DARK_BG);
+        panel.setBorder(new javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(5, 10, 5, 10));
+
+        // Group results by category
+        java.util.Map<String, List<TestResult>> grouped = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
+        for (TestResult r : results) {
+            grouped.computeIfAbsent(r.category, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(r);
+        }
+
+        // Build HTML content
+        StringBuilder html = new StringBuilder();
+        html.append("<html><body style='color:#DCDCDC; font-family:Arial; font-size:13px; margin:10px;'>");
+
+        for (var entry : grouped.entrySet()) {
+            String category = entry.getKey();
+            List<TestResult> categoryResults = entry.getValue();
+
+            int catPassed = 0;
+            int catFailed = 0;
+            for (TestResult r : categoryResults) {
+                if (r.passed) catPassed++;
+                else catFailed++;
+            }
+
+            // Category header
+            String catColor = catFailed > 0 ? "#DC9C3C" : "#50C850";
+            html.append("<div style='margin-bottom:15px;'>");
+            html.append("<h3 style='color:").append(catColor).append("; margin:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #3C3C50; padding-bottom:5px;'>");
+            html.append(escapeHtml(category)).append(" (").append(catPassed).append("/").append(categoryResults.size()).append(" passed)");
+            html.append("</h3>");
+
+            // Test results
+            for (TestResult r : categoryResults) {
+                String icon = r.passed ? "✅" : "❌";
+                String textColor = r.passed ? "#50C850" : "#DC3C3C";
+                html.append("<div style='margin:3px 0; padding:3px 5px; background-color:#232336; border-radius:3px;'>");
+                html.append("<span style='color:").append(textColor).append("'>").append(icon).append("</span> ");
+                html.append("<span style='color:#DCDCDC'>").append(escapeHtml(r.testName)).append("</span>");
+                if (r.errorMessage != null) {
+                    html.append("<br><span style='color:#DC9C3C; font-size:11px; margin-left:22px;'>⚠ ")
+                            .append(escapeHtml(r.errorMessage)).append("</span>");
+                }
+                html.append("</div>");
+            }
+
+            html.append("</div>");
+        }
+
+        html.append("</body></html>");
+
+        JTextPane textPane = new JTextPane();
+        textPane.setContentType("text/html");
+        textPane.setText(html.toString());
+        textPane.setEditable(false);
+        textPane.setBackground(DARK_BG);
+        textPane.setForeground(TEXT_COLOR);
+        textPane.setBorder(new javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(5, 5, 5, 5));
+
+        JScrollPane scrollPane = new JScrollPane(textPane);
+        scrollPane.setBackground(DARK_BG);
+        scrollPane.getViewport().setBackground(DARK_BG);
+        scrollPane.setBorder(new javax.swing.border.LineBorder(BORDER_COLOR, 1));
+
+        // Style scrollbar
+        JScrollBar vBar = scrollPane.getVerticalScrollBar();
+        vBar.setBackground(new Color(40, 40, 55));
+        vBar.setUnitIncrement(16);
+
+        panel.add(scrollPane, BorderLayout.CENTER);
+        return panel;
+    }
+
+    private JPanel createFooterPanel(List<TestResult> results) {
+        JPanel panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(10, 5));
+        panel.setBackground(PANEL_BG);
+        panel.setBorder(new javax.swing.border.CompoundBorder(
+                new javax.swing.border.LineBorder(BORDER_COLOR, 1),
+                new javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(10, 15, 15, 15)
+        ));
+
+        int total = results.size();
+        int passed = 0;
+        for (TestResult r : results) {
+            if (r.passed) passed++;
+        }
+        int failed = total - passed;
+
+        // Overall status
+        JLabel statusLabel;
+        if (failed == 0) {
+            statusLabel = new JLabel("🎉 All 3D view tests passed! The game is ready for turn 1.");
+            statusLabel.setForeground(ACCENT_GREEN);
+        } else {
+            statusLabel = new JLabel("⚠️ " + failed + " test(s) failed. Check the details above.");
+            statusLabel.setForeground(ACCENT_YELLOW);
+        }
+        statusLabel.setFont(new Font("Arial", Font.PLAIN, 12));
+        panel.add(statusLabel, BorderLayout.CENTER);
+
+        // Close button
+        JButton closeButton = new JButton("Close");
+        closeButton.setBackground(ACCENT_BLUE);
+        closeButton.setForeground(Color.WHITE);
+        closeButton.setFocusPainted(false);
+        closeButton.setFont(new Font("Arial", Font.BOLD, 12));
+        closeButton.addActionListener(e -> dispose());
+        panel.add(closeButton, BorderLayout.EAST);
+
+        return panel;
+    }
+
+    private String escapeHtml(String text) {
+        if (text == null) return "";
+        return text.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;")
+                .replace("\"", "&quot;").replace("'", "&#39;");
+    }
+}
```

#### src\test\java\com\yisy\modules\doramcu\hex\gui\ThreeDViewTest.java

```diff
--- a/src\test\java\com\yisy\modules\doramcu\hex\gui\ThreeDViewTest.java
+++ b/src\test\java\com\yisy\modules\doramcu\hex\gui\ThreeDViewTest.java
@@ -1,0 +1,506 @@
+package com.yisy.modules.doramcu.hex.gui;
+
+import com.yisy.modules.doramcu.hex.Game;
+import com.yisy.modules.doramcu.hex.Galaxy;
+import com.yisy.modules.doramcu.hex.Player;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
+import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
+
+import java.util.ArrayList;
+import java.util.List;
+
+import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
+
+/**
+ * Comprehensive tests for 3D view functionality in the GameHUD.
+ * Tests ViewProvider interface, EmpireViewProvider, Game3DPanel constants,
+ * and the integration between view providers and the game engine.
+ *
+ * These tests run without a display, testing the logic and data flow
+ * rather than the actual JavaFX rendering.
+ */
+@DisplayName("3D View Functionality Tests")
+class ThreeDViewTest {
+
+    // ==================== ViewProvider Interface Tests ====================
+
+    @Test
+    @DisplayName("ViewProvider should define all required methods")
+    void testViewProviderInterface() {
+        List<String> methods = new ArrayList<>();
+        for (var m : ViewProvider.class.getMethods()) {
+            methods.add(m.getName());
+        }
+        assertTrue(methods.contains("getName"), "ViewProvider should have getName()");
+        assertTrue(methods.contains("getIcon"), "ViewProvider should have getIcon()");
+        assertTrue(methods.contains("build3DContent"), "ViewProvider should have build3DContent()");
+        assertTrue(methods.contains("refresh3DContent"), "ViewProvider should have refresh3DContent()");
+        assertTrue(methods.contains("getTextContent"), "ViewProvider should have getTextContent()");
+        assertTrue(methods.contains("refresh"), "ViewProvider should have refresh()");
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    @DisplayName("ViewProvider.ViewSwitcher should define switchTo method")
+    void testViewSwitcherInterface() {
+        List<String> methods = new ArrayList<>();
+        for (var m : ViewProvider.ViewSwitcher.class.getMethods()) {
+            methods.add(m.getName());
+        }
+        assertTrue(methods.contains("switchTo"), "ViewSwitcher should have switchTo()");
+    }
+
+    // ==================== ViewType Enum Tests ====================
+
+    @Test
+    @DisplayName("ViewType enum should have all 16 view types")
+    void testViewTypeCount() {
+        EmpireViewProvider.ViewType[] types = EmpireViewProvider.ViewType.values();
+        assertEquals(16, types.length, "Should have 16 view types");
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    @DisplayName("ViewType enum should contain all expected views")
+    void testViewTypeValues() {
+        EmpireViewProvider.ViewType[] types = EmpireViewProvider.ViewType.values();
+        List<String> typeNames = new ArrayList<>();
+        for (var t : types) {
+            typeNames.add(t.name());
+        }
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("EMPIRE"), "Should have EMPIRE view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("PLANETS"), "Should have PLANETS view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("FLEETS"), "Should have FLEETS view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("GALAXY"), "Should have GALAXY view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("SHIPYARD"), "Should have SHIPYARD view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("HOME_SYSTEM"), "Should have HOME_SYSTEM view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("EVENT_LOG"), "Should have EVENT_LOG view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("BUILD_SHIP"), "Should have BUILD_SHIP view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("DESIGN_SHIP"), "Should have DESIGN_SHIP view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("HULL_VIEW"), "Should have HULL_VIEW view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("DORA_AI"), "Should have DORA_AI view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("SETTINGS"), "Should have SETTINGS view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("GENERATE_GALAXY"), "Should have GENERATE_GALAXY view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("JOIN_GALAXY"), "Should have JOIN_GALAXY view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("COMBAT"), "Should have COMBAT view");
+        assertTrue(typeNames.contains("RESEARCH"), "Should have RESEARCH view");
+    }
+
+    // ==================== EmpireViewProvider Tests ====================
+
+    @Test
+    @DisplayName("EmpireViewProvider should return correct name and icon")
+    void testEmpireViewProviderNameAndIcon() {
+        Game game = new Game("Test Game");
+        Player player = new Player(1, "Test Empire");
+        game.createPlayer(1, "Test Empire");
+        EmpireViewProvider provider = new EmpireViewProvider(player, game, null);
+        assertEquals("Empire", provider.getName());
+        assertEquals("\uD83D\uDC51", provider.getIcon());
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    @DisplayName("EmpireViewProvider should not throw on getTextContent with empty game")
+    void testEmpireViewProviderTextContent() {
+        Game game = new Game("Test Game");
+        Player player = new Player(1, "Test Empire");
+        game.createPlayer(1, "Test Empire");
+        EmpireViewProvider provider = new EmpireViewProvider(player, game, null);
+        String content = provider.getTextContent();
+        assertNotNull(content, "Text content should not be null");
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    @DisplayName("EmpireViewProvider should not throw on refresh with empty game")
+    void testEmpireViewProviderRefresh() {
+        Game game = new Game("Test Game");
+        Player player = new Player(1, "Test Empire");
+        game.createPlayer(1, "Test Empire");
+        EmpireViewProvider provider = new EmpireViewProvider(player, game, null);
```

- **ThreeDViewTest.java** (new, 36 tests): Comprehensive JUnit 5 test class covering ViewProvider interface methods, all 16 ViewType enum values, Game3DPanel constants (colors, camera bounds, grid), all view providers (Empire, Galaxy, Combat, Research, Planets, Fleets, Shipyard, EventLog), game integration (turn tracking, time advancement, turn duration), and turn 1 readiness validation.
- **Turn1TestResultsModal.java** (new): Swing JDialog that runs 18 manual tests at runtime covering all 3D view components, displays results in a dark-themed HTML-formatted modal grouped by category with pass/fail indicators, and includes header with summary badge, scrollable results panel, and footer with overall status.
- **GameHUD.java** (+14 lines): Added `turn1TestModalShown` flag and trigger logic in the turn progress timer callback that detects when `currentTurn == 1` and shows the test results modal once.

### Verification
- All 36 ThreeDViewTest tests pass (BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- Main code compiles successfully (`gradlew compileJava` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- Test code compiles successfully (`gradlew compileTestJava` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL)

### Notes
- The modal appears automatically when the game clock advances to turn 1 via the real-time timer sync
- Tests cover logic and data flow without requiring a display, so they run in headless environments
- The modal uses manual test execution rather than JUnit Platform to avoid classpath issues at runtime

```diff
+            int successCount = 0;
+            StringBuilder failures = new StringBuilder();
+
+            for (int i = 0; i < providers.length; i++) {
+                ViewProvider provider = providers[i];
+                try {
+                    provider.refresh();
+                    javafx.scene.Group group = new javafx.scene.Group();
+                    provider.build3DContent(group);
+                    provider.refresh3DContent();
+                    String content = provider.getTextContent();
+                    if (content != null) {
+                        successCount++;
+                    } else {
+                        failures.append("Key ").append(keyLabels[i]).append(" (").append(provider.getName()).append("): null content\n");
+                    }
+                } catch (Exception e) {
+                    failures.append("Key ").append(keyLabels[i]).append(" (").append(provider.getName()).append("): ").append(e.getMessage()).append("\n");
+                }
+            }
+
+            boolean passed = successCount == providers.length;
+            String detail = successCount + "/" + providers.length + " views functional";
+            if (!passed) {
+                detail += ". Failures: " + failures.toString().trim();
+            }
+            return new TestResult("Function Key Cycle", "All 10 views (keys 1-0): " + detail, passed,
+                    passed ? null : failures.toString().trim());
+        } catch (Exception e) {
+            return new TestResult("Function Key Cycle", "All 10 views (keys 1-0)", false, e.getMessage());
+        }
+    }
```

## Task result

The program locked up because the JavaFX Application Thread is permanently blocked.

### Root Cause

In `GameHUD.java`, the `initializeJavaFX()` method (line 1499-1540) keeps the JavaFX thread alive using this pattern:

```java
javafx.application.Platform.runLater(() -> {
    try {
        java.lang.Thread.sleep(Long.MAX_VALUE);  // ← Blocks FX thread forever
    } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
    }
});
```

This means **every subsequent `Platform.runLater()` call queues behind an infinite sleep** and never executes. The initial `Game3DPanel` scene builds because it uses a `CountDownLatch` that waits for the FX thread — but the latch times out after 10 seconds, and the scene may not fully initialize.

After the GameHUD displays, the 2-second refresh timer fires `refreshLightweight()`, which calls `runOnFXThread()` → `Platform.runLater()` to update 3D content. These tasks queue up but never run because the FX thread is sleeping forever. Meanwhile, `SwingUtilities.invokeLater()` calls accumulate on the EDT. Eventually both threads are saturated with queued tasks, and the UI freezes completely.

### Fix

Replace the `Thread.sleep(Long.MAX_VALUE)` pattern with a proper keep-alive mechanism using a `CountDownLatch` that only releases when the application shuts down:

```java
// In GameHUD.java, replace lines 1506-1523 with:
private static volatile CountDownLatch fxThreadKeepAlive = new CountDownLatch(1);

private static void initializeJavaFX() {
    if (javaFXInitialized) {
        if (!javaFXAvailable) {
            throw new RuntimeException("JavaFX is not available on this system");
        }
        return;
    }
    CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch(1);
    final boolean[] success = {true};
    Thread initThread = new Thread(() -> {
        try {
            javafx.application.Platform.startup(() -> {
                latch.countDown();
                // Keep FX thread alive by waiting on a latch instead of sleeping forever
                try {
                    fxThreadKeepAlive.await();
                } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
                }
            });
        } catch (Exception e) {
            success[0] = false;
            latch.countDown();
            log.error("Failed to initialize JavaFX: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }, "JavaFX-Init-Thread");
    initThread.setDaemon(true);
    initThread.start();
    try {
        latch.await(10, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        javaFXInitialized = true;
        javaFXAvailable = false;
        throw new RuntimeException("JavaFX initialization interrupted", e);
    }
    javaFXInitialized = true;
    if (!success[0]) {
        javaFXAvailable = false;
        throw new RuntimeException("JavaFX failed to initialize - native libraries may be missing");
    }
}
```

This allows `Platform.runLater()` tasks to execute normally while keeping the FX thread alive until the application exits.

## Task result

Fixed the "readiness failed for homeplanet sector and subsector" issue in the Turn 1 readiness tests.

### Changes
- **HomeSystemViewProvider.java**: Completely rewrote `refresh3DContent()` and `getTextContent()` to use the game player's home sector/subsector coordinates (`getHomeSectorRow/Col`, `getHomeSubSectorRow/Col`, `getHomeSectorName()`, `getHomeSubSectorName()`) instead of searching for any controlled sector in the galaxy. Added `findGamePlayer()` helper method to locate the game player by matching the hex player's ID. The text content now displays full home system details: system ID, planet ID, sector name, subsector name, and positions.
- **Turn1TestResultsModal.java**: Updated 3 test methods (`testHomeSystemViewProvider`, `test3DView_HomeSystem`, `testFunctionKeyViewCycle`) to properly set up home sector/subsector data on the game player before testing, so the readiness tests have valid data to verify.

### Verification
- Compilation successful (`gradlew compileJava` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- All 349 service/config/controller tests passed (BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 32s)
- All 47+ hex core tests passed (BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 26s)
- ThreeDViewTest passed (BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 3s)

### Notes
- The root cause was that `HomeSystemViewProvider` searched for any controlled sector in the galaxy, but in test environments (and early game states), no sectors are marked as controlled. The fix uses the player's actual home sector/subsector coordinates which are set during initialization by `PlanetManager.setupHomeSystem()`.

## Task result

Fixed the DebugDisplay showing null values for home sector and subsector information.

### Changes
- **DebugDisplay.java** (3 sections updated): Changed all empire/player info display to read from `hex.player.Player` objects in the game session's `Game` instance instead of JPA `model.Player` entities. The JPA entities have no home sector fields, which is why they showed null. +    private static void bringToFront(Window window) {

```diff
+        window.toFront();
+        window.requestFocusInWindow();
```

### Changes
- **GameLauncher.java**: Added `bringToFront(Window)` helper that pulses `setAlwaysOnTop(true)`, calls `toFront()` and `requestFocusInWindow()`, then removes always-on-top after 500ms. Applied to all 4 windows: startup dialog, DebugDisplay, LoginWindow, and GameHUD.
- **DebugDisplay.java**: Added `toFront()`, `requestFocusInWindow()`, and `setAlwaysOnTop(true)` pulse to the database cleanup confirmation dialog so it appears in front.
- **Turn1TestResultsModal.java**: Added `toFront()`, `requestFocusInWindow()`, and `setAlwaysOnTop(true)` pulse to the test results modal. Fixed `testAllProvidersAtTurn1()` readiness test to include all 10 view providers (added HomeSystemViewProvider, SettingsViewProvider, ShipyardViewProvider, EventLogViewProvider) with proper home sector/subsector data setup.

- Compilation successful (`gradlew compileJava` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- 125 controller tests: All passed
- 349 service/config/DTO/exception/state machine/model tests: All passed
- Core hex tests (Game, Hex, Galaxy, Empire, Planet): All passed

### Notes
- The `setAlwaysOnTop(true)` pulse is a well-known technique to force a Swing window above other applications on Windows; it's removed after 500ms so the window doesn't stay permanently on top.
- The CombatResolverTest failure seen during testing is a pre-existing issue unrelated to these changes.

### Troubleshooting Windows Voice Typing

Windows Voice Typing (`Win + H`) can sometimes stop working. Here are the most common fixes:

#### Quick Fix: Reset Voice Typing

1. **Press `Win + H`** — does the small microphone bar appear?
   - **If yes**: The microphone icon should be blue/orange when listening. Click it to toggle on/off.
   - **If no**: Continue reading below.

#### Check Microphone Permissions

1. Press `Win + I` to open **Settings**
2. Go to **Privacy & security → Microphone**
3. Ensure **"Microphone access"** is turned **On**
4. Scroll down and ensure **"Let apps access your microphone"** is **On**
5. Make sure your IDE (IntelliJ IDEA) is listed and allowed

#### Check Microphone Hardware

1. Right-click the **speaker icon** in your system tray
2. Select **Sounds** → **Recording** tab
3. Verify your microphone is listed and shows green bars when you speak
4. If no microphone is detected, check your hardware connections

#### Reset Voice Typing Service

1. Press `Win + R`, type `services.msc`, press Enter
2. Find **"Windows Audio"** service
3. Right-click → **Restart**
4. Try `Win + H` again

#### Alternative: Use JetBrains IDE Voice Plugin

If Windows Voice Typing continues to have issues, you can install a dedicated voice plugin:

1. Go to **File → Settings → Plugins → Marketplace**
2. Search for **"Voice Code"** (by OpenVoiceOS)
3. Click **Install** and restart the IDE
4. This provides voice commands directly inside the IDE

### Fix 1: Enable Online Speech Recognition (Most Common Fix)

This is the #1 cause when the mic appears but no text is produced:

1. Press `Win + I` to open **Settings**
2. Go to **Privacy & security → Speech**
3. Make sure **"Online speech recognition"** is turned **ON**
4. If it was already on, toggle it **OFF**, wait 5 seconds, then toggle it **ON** again

Windows Voice Typing uses Azure cloud services to convert speech to text. If this toggle is off, the microphone will appear but won't produce any text.

---

### Fix 2: Install Speech Language Pack

If the speech language pack is missing, dictation won't work:

1. Press `Win + I` → **Time & language → Speech**
2. Under **Speech language**, check that your language (e.g., English) is selected
3. Click **Manage voices** and ensure at least one voice is installed
4. If no voice is listed, click **Add voices** and download one

---

### Fix 3: Check Microphone Input Level

The mic might be selected but the volume too low:

1. Press `Win + I` → **System → Sound**
2. Under **Input**, verify your microphone is selected
3. Speak aloud — the **input level bar** should move
4. If it doesn't move, click **Properties** and increase the **Input volume**

---

### Fix 4: Restart the Speech Service

1. Press `Win + R`, type `services.msc`, press Enter
2. Find **"Windows Audio"** service
3. Right-click → **Restart**
4. Try `Win + H` again

---

### Quick Test Sequence

After applying Fix 1 (Online speech recognition):

2. Press `Win + H`
3. Wait 2–3 seconds for the microphone to activate (it should turn blue/orange)
4. Say a clear phrase like **"hello world"**
5. Check if text appears

### Deep Dive: Why Windows Voice Typing Fails (and How to Fix It)

Since the standard fixes didn't work, let's try the **advanced solutions** that resolve the most stubborn cases:

---

#### Fix 1: Install Enhanced Speech Recognition Language Pack (Most Likely Cause)

Microsoft support confirms this is the #1 cause when the mic appears but produces no text:

1. Press `Win + I` → **Time & language → Language & region**
2. Find your language (e.g., "English (United States)")
3. Click the **three dots (⋯)** → **Language options**
4. Scroll down to **Speech** section
5. If you don't see an **Enhanced speech recognition** model listed, click **Download**
6. If it's already listed, click **Remove**, wait 30 seconds, then **Download** again
7. After downloading, **restart your computer** and try `Win + H` again

---

#### Fix 2: Re-register Windows Speech Apps

The speech recognition apps may be corrupted:

1. Open **PowerShell as Administrator** (right-click Start → Windows Terminal (Admin))
2. Run this command to re-register all speech-related apps:

```powershell
Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers *Microsoft.Windows.Speech* | Foreach {Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register "$($_.InstallLocation)\AppXManifest.xml"}
```

3. Also re-register the Windows Feature Experience Pack:

```powershell
Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers *Windows.FeatureExperience* | Foreach {Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register "$($_.InstallLocation)\AppXManifest.xml"}
```

4. **Restart your computer** and try again

---

#### Fix 3: Check Windows Update Services

Voice Typing depends on Windows Update services. If they're disabled, dictation fails:

1. Press `Win + R`, type `services.msc`, press Enter
2. Find these services and ensure they're **Running** and set to **Automatic**:
   - **Windows Update**
   - **Windows Audio**
   - **Windows Audio Endpoint Builder**
3. If any are stopped, right-click → **Start**
4. Try `Win + H` again

---

#### Fix 4: Reset Speech Settings via Registry

⚠️ **Warning:** Only proceed if you're comfortable editing the registry:

1. Press `Win + R`, type `regedit`, press Enter
2. Navigate to: `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Speech_OneCore`
3. Right-click the `Speech_OneCore` folder → **Export** (backup)
4. Right-click the `Speech_OneCore` folder → **Delete**
5. **Restart your computer** — Windows will recreate the registry keys fresh
6. Try `Win + H` again

---

#### Fix 5: Try Windows Voice Access Instead

If Voice Typing continues to fail, **Voice Access** is the more powerful alternative:

1. Press `Win + I` → **Accessibility → Speech**
2. Turn **ON** "Voice Access"
3. Click **Get** to download if needed
4. This provides a more robust speech recognition interface that works independently of Voice Typing

---

#### Alternative: Use JetBrains IDE Voice Plugin

Since you're using IntelliJ IDEA, the **Voice Code** plugin works directly inside the IDE without relying on Windows Voice Typing:

1. Go to **File → Settings → Plugins → Marketplace**
2. Search for **"Voice Code"** (by OpenVoiceOS)
3. Click **Install** and restart the IDE
4. This uses Whisper AI for speech recognition and provides coding-specific voice commands

---

**Which fix would you like to try first?** I recommend starting with **Fix 1** (Enhanced Speech Recognition pack) as it's the most common cause of your specific symptom. If that doesn't work, **Fix 5** (Voice Access) is the most reliable alternative.

### Try Voice Access Instead (More Reliable Than Voice Typing)

Windows **Voice Access** is a separate, more powerful speech recognition system that often works when Voice Typing fails:

1. Press `Win + I` → **Accessibility → Speech**
2. Turn **ON** "Voice Access"
3. If it prompts you to download, click **Get** and wait for the download to complete
4. Once enabled, a floating microphone bar will appear at the bottom of the screen
5. Click the microphone icon to start listening
6. Speak into the Junie chat input — Voice Access will type your words

Voice Access uses a different engine than Voice Typing and is less dependent on the online speech services that Voice Typing relies on.

---

### If Voice Access Also Doesn't Work: Try JetBrains Voice Code Plugin

Since you're using IntelliJ IDEA, the **Voice Code** plugin is the most reliable option for voice input in the IDE:

1. Go to **File → Settings → Plugins → Marketplace**
2. Search for **"Voice Code"** (by OpenVoiceOS)
3. Click **Install** and restart the IDE
4. After restart, you'll see a microphone icon in the IDE toolbar
5. Click it and start speaking — it uses Whisper AI for speech recognition

Voice Code works entirely within the IDE and doesn't depend on Windows speech services at all.
